data.status: implemented, tested, committed; worktree handed off
delivered: Three top-level entries in order 会话列表 → 文件列表 → 控制面板; every open/full reload defaults to 会话列表 with no persisted tab state; 控制面板 name/behavior unchanged.

Equal-width tabs with visible selected state and focus ring; Tab focuses each entry, Enter/Space activate, ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End cycle selection and focus; touch swipe does not switch top-level tabs.

New 文件列表 tab: server absolute-path input, no client file picker; register ordinary existing directories and real Git worktree roots; invalid/missing/relative/file/duplicate paths rejected with explicit JSON codes.

Backend-persisted workspace registry shared by all callers; real process restart retains the list. Storage path configurable via optional [workspaces] registry_file (default workspaces.json in process CWD).

Registration returns success only after atomic persistence (temp file + sync_all + rename); read failure, corruption, and write failure are explicit errors and never overwrite the original or masquerade as an empty list.
Unregister only removes the registry entry; neither API nor UI deletes or modifies directories/files.

criteria_evidence.evidence: backend/tests/workspace_registry.rs snapshots file bytes before unregister and compares after; real Chromium unregistered alpha, success text states 目录与文件未删除, and alpha/note.txt + nested/inner.txt remained byte-identical.

criteria_evidence.criterion: Success only after persistence; isolated write/read/corruption failures; no empty-list disguise or silent overwrite; re-read and restart
